sections.title: From a Texaco station *to Whiskey Road*
body: Cebie Williamson opened his first gas station in Aiken in 1967: a Texaco open around the clock with five bays. Within a few years he was running all three Texaco stations in town.

When the full-service stations closed in the early 1980s, he saw the growth coming to Aiken, bought ten acres on Whiskey Road and built an automotive shop. His son Ronnie, who started working for his dad at thirteen, owns it today.
Some customers have been coming to Ronnie for more than thirty years. Honesty and good work are what carried the shop this far.
